subject: unpaired analysis with different number of normal and tumor samples

messages.author: 1e9533b2bf521f06
messages.subject: unpaired analysis with different number of normal and tumor samples
parts:
I have an unpaired analysis to do. The dataset is Affymetrix SNP_6
array. I have 88 normal samples and 145 tumor samples.

Question: If I want to use the normal samples as the reference set ,
how do I go about doing the analysis, starting from uploading the
samples. Do I have to upload all the tumor and normal samples
together?

thanks
Manisha

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: unpaired analysis with different number of normal and tumor  samples
parts:
Hi Manisha,

If you want to use the normals as a reference in an unpaired analysis
you will have to do something like taking the robust average. There
was a response on the group a couple of weeks ago (May 17) about just
such a problem. Do a search for "reference set" and you should find
it (the "Search this group" button at the top-right of the group
page).

Cheers,

Ken
